description: Detect all cases where the runtime bypasses the DEX execution path and uses direct C++ calls instead. This is the core validation of EXP-013.

detection_criteria.direct_renderer_calls: Check if renderer is called without going through View.draw() from DEX
detection_criteria.direct_view_creation: Check if Views are created without new-instance opcode
detection_criteria.hardcoded_textview_text: Check if TextView text is set without setText() dispatch
detection_criteria.manual_lifecycle_calls: Check if lifecycle methods are called without DEX invocation

detected_bypasses.title: TextView created via C++ heap allocation, not new-instance opcode
detected_bypasses.description: The runtime creates TextView objects using heap_->create_text_view() directly in C++. This bypasses the DEX new-instance (0x22) opcode that should allocate the object in the interpreter's object space.

should_be_dex_path: 3. Register v1 now holds valid TextView reference
evidence.impact: Object creation is invisible to DEX execution trace. Cannot verify object lifecycle.

detected_bypasses.workaround_used: Direct C++ object instantiation after interpreter halt
detected_bypasses.recommendation: Implement new-instance opcode with object heap integration

detected_bypasses.title: Text set via direct C++ call, not from DEX register after const-string
detected_bypasses.description: The const-string opcode correctly loads 'Hello MiniAndroid' into register v0. However, this value is NEVER used by subsequent code. Instead, text is extracted from resources and set directly via text_view->set_text().

evidence.data_flow_gap: const-string result -> register v0 -> [LOST] -> text set from resource parser

detected_bypasses.impact: The only executed DEX instruction's result is discarded. Proves DEX execution is not connected to output.
detected_bypasses.recommendation: Implement invoke-virtual to dispatch setText with register values as arguments

detected_bypasses.title: Lifecycle methods called via state machine, not DEX method invocation
detected_bypasses.description: Activity.onCreate(), onStart(), onResume() are recorded as state transitions but never entered through the DEX interpreter. The interpreter is only invoked for onCreate, halts, then fallback handles everything.

evidence.actual_execution: Only onCreate attempted via DEX, halted after 1 instruction

detected_bypasses.impact: Lifecycle is a simulation, not real Android lifecycle through bytecode execution.

detected_bypasses.title: Renderer called directly, not through View.draw() dispatch chain
detected_bypasses.description: The software renderer draws the frame by directly iterating the object heap, not by invoking draw() methods on each View through DEX invoke-virtual opcodes.

should_be_dex_path: 1. Root view invokes draw(canvas) via invoke-virtual
2. Each child view's draw() executes recursively
3. Canvas operations dispatched through more invoke-virtual calls
evidence.missing_dispatch_chain: No invoke-virtual for View.draw(Canvas), no Canvas object creation via DEX

detected_bypasses.impact: Rendering works but is completely outside DEX execution model.

detected_bypasses.title: View dimensions hardcoded, not calculated from measure()/layout() pass
detected_bypasses.description: View positions and sizes are assigned constant values rather than calculated through the Android measure/layout algorithm which should execute via DEX method calls.

should_be_dex_path: 2. Each view calculates its size in onMeasure()
3. rootview.layout(l, t, r, b) via invoke-virtual
4. Each view positions itself in onLayout()
evidence.impact: Layout is static, not responsive to content or constraints.

evidence.title: Resources loaded via C++ parser, not Context.getResources()
evidence.description: String and layout resources are loaded using the C++ ResourceParser directly, rather than through the Android Resource system which would involve Context.getResources() calls dispatched via DEX.

should_be_dex_path: 4. View root = inflater.inflate(R.layout.activity_main, null); via invoke-virtual
evidence.impact: Resource resolution works but bypasses Android resource framework.

root_cause_analysis.primary_root_cause: DEX Interpreter only implements const-string (0x1A). All other opcodes halt execution.
consequence_chain: 1. new-instance not implemented → cannot create objects via DEX
2. invoke-* not implemented → cannot call any methods via DEX
3. return-* not implemented → cannot complete methods via DEX
4. Runtime falls back to C++ simulation after interpreter halt
5. All post-halt work is BYPASS of DEX execution path

detected_bypasses.verdict: The MiniAndroid runtime has EXTENSIVE bypasses of the DEX execution path. While the infrastructure for real execution exists (APK→Manifest→DEX→ClassResolver→Interpreter entry), the actual application logic execution is entirely simulated in C++. This is honestly documented - no fake success claims.

remediation_priority.effort: High - need method resolution + argument passing
